description: This file defines the JobTitleService class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods for managing job titles, including retrieving, saving, and deleting job titles, as well as handling related attachments. It acts as a service layer that interacts with the Data Access Object (DAO), JobTitleDao, and provides normalized data for use elsewhere in the application.

classes.name: JobTitleService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for managing job titles and related attachments, acting as an intermediary between controllers and data access layer, and offering normalization of data for external use.

methods.name: getJobTitleDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JobTitleDao instance used for database operations related to job titles.

methods.name: setJobTitleDao
methods.description: Sets the JobTitleDao instance, allowing dependency injection for testing or custom implementations.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job titles, optionally only active ones based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Flags specified job titles as deleted in the database.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Fetches a specific JobTitle entity by its ID.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobSpecificationAttachment entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Persists a JobTitle entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Deletes (or flags as deleted) a JobSpecificationAttachment entity.

methods.name: getJobTitleArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized JobTitleModel representations of all job titles.

methods.name: getJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized JobTitleModels associated with a specific employee number.
